agent.name: Promethean Technology Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Technology significance and bounded application implications

analytical_question: Does the significance of indoor autonomous delivery robots justify a pilot at the hypothetical large restaurant?
general_et_finding: Prospective classification: Breakthrough, with moderate confidence, rather than Potential Promethean. The unit is an integrated indoor wheeled delivery system. Compared with manually carrying a tray or pushing a cart, it can perform a route without a person accompanying each trip, as a supplier-reported capability in E2-E3. The candidate barrier is human escort in the conventional delivery workflow. This is not a universal historical requirement because automated transport already existed. Physical goods still have to traverse space and site constraints remain. Suppressing this robot class would plausibly restore staff carrying and carts, not collapse multiple essential societal systems; that is a counterfactual inference. Restaurant and hotel delivery remain mainly economic activity rather than two proven tiers of dissolution. The categorical-dissolution gate is not met, so six-criterion scoring is not reached: tenfold gains, wide societal impact, a civilizational paradigm shift, dependent innovation waves, democratized access and irreversibility are not demonstrated by these sources. Breakthrough refers to the bounded autonomous task capability relative to manual carrying, not every product upgrade.
application_finding: Kitchen-to-table carrying is an incremental improvement to an existing restaurant workflow. Staff still load trays and complete service. Whether the restaurant gains value depends on the full workflow, not the robot's novelty.
organization_specific_finding: The large restaurant is a moderate/fast-follower with space, a supervisor and charging access as assumptions. These support considering a controlled pilot, subject to site checks. The 1.2 m route assumption is not a safety assessment.

evidence.source_or_reference: Fortino, Chapter 11, August 2026 draft, sections 11.2 and 11.7; supplied PDF.

evidence.claim: E2 describes an available restaurant delivery system.
evidence.notes: Does not independently prove this site's safety or ROI.
One reported integration does not prove universal compatibility.

evidence.claim: E4 describes continuing space, mapping and human-support requirements for Servi Plus.
evidence.notes: A different model's instructions; do not transfer numerical limits to BellaBot Pro.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Sources are mainly suppliers, not independent site trials.
Staff support and physical operating conditions persist.
No local cost, intervention or service measurements are supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in a bounded Breakthrough interpretation relative to manual carrying. The hypothetical organization has not been assessed; no safety, payback or irreversible societal-change claim is supported.
value_opportunity_implication: Reduce repetitive walking so staff can spend more attention on other service work, if the complete process improves.
risk_governance_implication: Keep human service responsibility, vendor-approved operation and manual fallback; this classification does not certify engineering safety.
recommendation_management_implication: Run a controlled pilot after a vendor site assessment and staff training. Compare service efficiency and staff workload with the current manual process, retain manual fallback and review costs before expanding.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess if local efficiency, staff workload or incidents change.
Reconsider broad significance only on credible cross-tier barrier removal and durable dependency, not popularity.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Require site assessment before live use.
Obtain local costs and outcomes before scaling.
Withhold Potential or Confirmed Promethean and any deployment-safety guarantee on this evidence.
